name: Noncitizen population by state and county (Census ACS, table B05001)
description: How many residents of each state, DC and county are not U.S. citizens, with the margin of error and the share of the population, from the Census Bureau's American Community Survey 5-year estimates (2020-2024), table B05001 (nativity and citizenship status). Each record also splits the citizens into born in the US, born in a U.S. territory, born abroad of American parents and naturalized. These are survey estimates of residents, not of legal status: the table does not separate lawful permanent residents, visa holders or anyone else.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). Noncitizen population by state and county (Census ACS, table B05001) (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963957

distribution.name: noncitizen-population.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: noncitizen-population.json

distribution.name: noncitizen-population-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in noncitizen-population-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to noncitizen-population.csv on id.
